description: This PHP class defines a UserPreferencesService within the Api\V8\Service namespace, responsible for retrieving user preferences from a database and returning the data as a structured JSON API response. It interacts with a BeanManager to get user beans, executes SQL queries to fetch preferences, unserializes and decodes data, and constructs a document response containing the preferences.

classes.name: UserPreferencesService
classes.description: Service class that provides functionality to retrieve user preferences from the database and return them in a standardized API response format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the BeanManager dependency.

methods.name: getUserPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves preferences for a specific user based on given parameters, queries the database for preference data, unserializes and decodes it, and returns a structured JSON API document containing the preferences.
